text.p: Top 10 films showing at Dutch cinemas (pvs week in brackets)
1 (-) SPACE JAM - Bugs Bunny and Looney Tunes gang team up with
U.S. basketball idol Michael Jordan for game against a
group of animated aliens.
2 (1) RANSOM - Mel Gibson turns tables on his son's kidnappers
in emotional drama.
3 (2) STAR TREK: FIRST CONTACT - The Enterprise crew travel
back in time to save the earth from the unfriendly Borg.
4 (3) THE FIRST WIVES CLUB - Comedy with Goldie Hawn, Bette
Midler and Diane Keaton seeking revenge on ex-husbands.
5 (4) EVITA - Madonna as Argentina's Eva Peron.
6 (7) HUNCHBACK OF NOTRE DAME - Latest Disney animation.
7 (5) DRAGONHEART - Adventure film set in middle-ages with Sean
Connery as voice of the dragon.
8 (-) THE MIRROR HAS TWO FACES - Romantic comedy about
initially platonic relationship. Stars director Barbra
Streisand, Jeff Bridges and Lauren Bacall.
9 (13) SHINE -
10 (-) MICROCOSMOS - Award-winning docu-film on insect world.
Source: Nederlandse Federatie voor Cinematografie.
Following is a selection of films PREMIERING this week:
101 DALMATIANS (101 ECHTE DALMATIERS) - Pongo and Perdita take
on fur-loving Cruella De Vil in re-make of Disney classic. Fun
for all the family.
THE RELIC - Hungry monster with a liking for human brains turns
up in Chicago museum but modern technology saves the day. Big,
animatronics film, also stars Penelope Ann Miller, Tom Sizemore.
THE ENGLISH PATIENT - Ralph Fiennes, Kristin Scott Thomas and
Juliette Binoche star in Oscar-nomination's surprise package
about love, death etc, from the maker of "Truly, Madly, Deeply".
